Definition: probably from G3528; victorious; Nicanor, a Christian:--Nicanor.
BiblicalUsage: Nicanor is one of the seven men the whole multitude chooses to serve the tables, named beside Stephen and Philip and Nicolas. He is chosen because the saying pleases the multitude, and his name is the whole of his record.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe being chosen by the whole church is honour enough: Nicanor's name stands among the seven, and that is where his story rests.
